'''Danu 1 (November 24)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - King [[Laman Damodred|Laman]], and Lord [[Aranvor Naldwinn]] are killed during the third day of the [[Battle of the Shining Walls]]. Laman's death marks the end of the [[Aiel War]], and the [[Aiel]] begin their trek back to the [[Aiel Waste|Waste]] the next day.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Egwene]] is formally raised [[Amyrlin]], with [[Sheriam]] as her [[Keeper]]. [[Theodrin]], [[Faolain]], [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] are raised to full [[Aes Sedai]]. Egwene takes control of [[Moghedien]]'s ''[[a'dam]]''.
